title: Saudi Arabia — Museums (متاحف المملكة العربية السعودية)
description: Directory of museums in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (matāḥif al-mamlaka al-ʿarabiyya al-saʿūdiyya). Each record contains the museum's Arabic name, administrative region and city, organisational status (public/private), thematic classification, working hours/days, year of establishment, ticket price in Saudi Riyals (SAR), and Friday opening status. Compiled from publicly published museum information by SalihaAlmalki on GitHub.
